summary: Frontend UI for a crypto short-analysis workflow (form, results, history, details dialog, disclaimer, and dark terminal theme) is added, but the backend remains the original Panda Cards canister and the frontend currently uses mocked, in-memory analysis/history instead of calling deterministic on-canister heuristic analysis endpoints. Static generated brand image files are referenced but not shown as added in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend data models and endpoints for crypto analysis requests/results, including per-user history keyed by caller principal; expose methods to submit analysis, list history, and fetch analysis by id; ensure analyses are private per principal and deterministic.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo still defines PandaCard types/storage and exposes panda-card-related methods (getAllCards/getRandomCard/getCardById/etc.). No evidence of crypto analysis types, submit/list/get endpoints, or per-caller storage in the backend diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement on-canister heuristic scoring engine computing technical indicators (at minimum RSI and moving averages) and return score/confidence, recommendation, and English reasons; return clear error when insufficient rows.
missing_requirements.reason: No indicator/heuristic engine implementation is shown in backend/main.mo; instead it still contains panda card initialization and a random card method using randomness. The only 'analysis' logic visible is a frontend mockAnalysis based on price change, not RSI/MAs.

missing_requirements.requirement: Connect the new frontend workflow to the backend using React Query, including loading/error/empty states, and a history view backed by the logged-in user’s canister-stored analyses.
missing_requirements.reason: React Query hooks exist, but they explicitly use a mockAnalysis function and local in-memory stores (latestAnalysisResult/analysisHistoryStore) with TODO comments to replace with backend calls. Therefore the workflow is not actually connected to backend endpoints nor backed by per-user canister history.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate and include static brand assets (logo + icon) under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them in the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: UI references an icon path (/assets/generated/crypto-short-icon.dim_128x128.png), but the diff summary does not show the required image files being added under frontend/public/assets/generated (neither the icon nor the 512x512 logo).

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend mock analysis engine and in-memory history store (latestAnalysisResult/analysisHistoryStore) instead of using backend canister methods.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires backend-based deterministic heuristic analysis and per-user history stored in the canister; the diff implements a temporary client-side mock with TODOs rather than requested backend integration.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend migration module and migration wiring in the actor.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request a data migration feature; a new backend/migration.mo is added and referenced via '(with migration = Migration.run)' in backend/main.mo.
